collection.description: Collection name for record subjects. Omit to accept every collection.

reportTypes.description: Report reason types this queue accepts (fully qualified NSIDs)

reporterTags.description: Match any listed tag on the account submitting the report.

accountTags.description: Match tags on the account that is being reported against. For record subjects, use the author account. Match any listed tag.

recommendedPolicies.description: Policy keys recommended when actioning reports in this queue

recommendedLabels.description: Labels recommended for this queue and used as a fallback when routing label appeals

createdBy.description: DID of moderator who created this queue

enabled.description: Whether this queue is currently active

deletedAt.description: When the queue was deleted, if applicable

strictAccess.description: Admins can always list this queue and browse its reports. Other roles require an active queue assignment. Individual report and moderation event access is unchanged.

pendingCount.description: Number of unmuted reports currently not closed.

closureTargetOverdueCount.description: Unmuted pending reports past their closure target.

closureTargetMetCount.description: Reports whose closure meets their closure target.

closureTargetMissedCount.description: Reports whose closure exceeds their closure target.

closureTargetMetRate.description: Percent of reports meeting their closure target.

closedCount.description: Number of reports whose current closure falls within this UTC calendar day.

actionedCount.description: Number of closures whose last report action is label, tag, or takedown.

acknowledgedCount.description: Number of closures whose last report action is not label, tag, or takedown.

escalatedCount.description: Number of report escalation events during this UTC calendar day.

inboundCount.description: Reports received in this queue during this UTC calendar day.

labelActionCount.description: Closures whose last report action is a label event.

tagActionCount.description: Closures whose last report action is a tag event.

takedownActionCount.description: Closures whose last report action is a takedown event.

ahtSampleCount.description: Number of assigned closed-report samples in ahtDurationSec.

resolutionSampleCount.description: Number of closed-report samples in resolutionDurationSec.

actionRate.description: Percentage of closures actioned (actionedCount / closedCount * 100), rounded to nearest integer.

avgHandlingTimeSec.description: Average handling time in seconds from report assignment to close.

avgResolutionTimeSec.description: Average resolution time in seconds from report creation to close.

lastUpdated.description: When these statistics were last computed.

moderator.description: The moderator assigned to this queue
